objective.name: sandbox.inspect.remote.trace
objective.description: Wrapper-backed capacity that inspects remote user traces by calling a remote wrapper-side trace observer.

#root.role: Call one remote wrapper-side local trace observer and summarize the first matching user trace event.

effects.remote_trace_projection: The wrapper emits one outbound wrapper-to-wrapper request to another context and summarizes the returned trace observation.

transformation_contract.morphing: A wrapper request becomes one remote wrapper-mediated trace inspection summary over user traces selected by reason_code and optionally narrowed to a recent time window.
invariants: The wrapper does not access remote trace files directly.
The wrapper always goes through a remote wrapper-side trace observer instead of reading traces itself.
The payload summarizes only the first matching event plus aggregate count.
success: On success, sandbox.inspect.remote.trace returns whether a matching remote user trace was found and the first matching event fields.
An empty result is a valid successful outcome expressed through found=false and event_count=0.
failure: The capability fails if the outbound remote wrapper inspection request cannot complete.
The capability does not mask errors returned by the remote wrapper-side trace observer.
notes: When from_ts_ns and to_ts_ns are provided, they are forwarded to the remote wrapper-side local trace observer.
This capacity is used as a remote wrapper-side trace observer in N7 system tests.
